# Eastside Lawnmower Repairs & Used Tire Sales & Service

> Used tires, flats & mower repair based in Austin, Texas. Used tires, fast flat repairs and lawnmower fixes under the blue roof at Brushy St and I-35. Honest work, a fair price, and you're back on the road.

- Phone: (512) 476-5372
- Based in: Austin, TX
- Service area: Austin, Pflugerville, Manor, Del Valle, Round Rock
- Google rating: 4.5 from 91 reviews
- Send a message: https://ronaks-code.github.io/sitelift-demos/small-engine-repair/texas/eastside-lawnmower-repairs/quote.html
- Book a visit: https://ronaks-code.github.io/sitelift-demos/small-engine-repair/texas/eastside-lawnmower-repairs/book.html

## Services
- Flats & patches: Picked up a nail? Pull in and we'll get it off, patched and back on, often in minutes, not hours.
- Used tires: Stacks of used tires out back for when you need one tire or a set without paying new-tire money.
- Lawnmower repair: Mower won't start, starter cord spinning, or just running rough? Bring it by, or bring just the broken part.

## About
Eastside Lawnmower Repairs & Used Tire Sales & Service sits at 104½ Brushy St in East Austin, a little jog of a street just off Cesar Chavez and the I-35 frontage. Look for the yellow-and-blue building with the East Side mural, the blue corrugated roof over the bay, and the used tire stacks underneath, with the downtown towers right over the highway. We do two things, Monday to Saturday: tires and mowers. Flats and nails patched while you wait, bent rims straightened, used tires sold and mounted (RVs too), and lawnmowers tuned up, cleaned out and brought back to life. Customers know Sammy and Johnathan by name. Bring cash, and se habla español. Customers say the same things again and again: fast (one flat was off, patched and back on in about ten minutes), honest about what's broken, even when the answer is that it isn't worth fixing, and priced fairly enough that people are a little surprised. Long-time neighbors, new neighbors and road-trippers heading out of town all end up here.

## Frequently asked questions
- Q: Do I need an appointment?
  A: No. Most customers just pull up, Monday to Saturday, 8 AM to 6 PM. If you want to check first, call (512) 476-5372.
- Q: Do you have used tires in my size?
  A: The stacks change all the time, so call (512) 476-5372 with your tire size (it's on the sidewall, like 225/65R17) and we'll tell you what we've got.
- Q: Can you fix a flat while I wait?
  A: Yes. Flats are what we do all day. Reviewers say it took five to fifteen minutes from pulling in to driving off, even for a nail close to the sidewall that other shops wouldn't touch.
- Q: How fast can you fix my mower?
  A: Often the same day. Customers have had a smoking, oil-flooded mower back in a few hours and a no-start mower running again in about five. If it isn't worth fixing, we'll tell you.
- Q: Can I bring in just the broken part of my mower?
  A: Yes. One customer brought only the pull-starter housing. We showed him the broken disk and swapped in a new one with a fresh cord.
- Q: Do you take cards?
  A: Bring cash. Customers have said for years that it's a cash shop, so cash is the safe bet.
- Q: ¿Hablan español?
  A: Sí. Se habla español, and English works too.
- Q: Where exactly are you?
  A: 104½ Brushy St, Austin, TX 78702, just off Cesar Chavez by the I-35 frontage. Look for the yellow-and-blue building with the blue roof and the tire stacks.
- Q: What are your hours?
  A: Monday to Saturday, 8 AM to 6 PM. Closed Sunday. Holiday hours can differ, so call ahead on a holiday.
